scenario_priors.cbo_collective: Corporate75/25; consumption-proxy product taxes; owner-property model retained and remaining property to observed capital; public assets collective per-capita; all domestic receipt pools mapped to household proxies
scenario_priors.federal_gap_high_agi: Keep modeled federal tax amounts; allocate only positive national federal residual by observed AGI>=500000 tax-carrier liability; matched2023 diagnostic locates aggregate undercoverage in this tail, without identifying2024 group shares
scenario_priors.treasury_815: Only corporate capital fraction changes to historical81.5%; CPS gains remain absent
scenario_priors.nas_80: Only corporate rule changes to80%interest/dividend,20%wages; does not reproduce full NAS model
scenario_priors.corporate_all_capital: Corporate endpoint100%capital; not a confidence bound
scenario_priors.property_residual_consumption: Only property receipts beyond modeled owner housing shift to consumption; broad pass-through stress, not empirical incidence estimate
scenario_priors.public_assets_tax_base: Only public-asset and enterprise-surplus ownership changes from population to federal modeled liability; causal response stays0
scenario_priors.capital_external_50: Assume50%of capital-attributed corporate, property-residual, other-production and business-transfer burden borne by foreign/nonresident owners; no measured foreign share
scenario_priors.capital_external_100: Same mathematical endpoint at100%; no measured foreign share
scenario_priors.medicare_income_weighted: Only SMI premiums weighted by positive AGI+1 among enrolled Medicare recipients; stress for income-related premiums, not statutory IRMAA reconstruction

fixed_rules.income_tax_source: Public liability cannot be identified by marginal labor/capital source. Entire income-tax liability exported as source_unknown; observed asset-income share is a separate proxy, never a measured capital-tax amount.
fixed_rules.credits: EITC+ACTC moved from negative federal receipts to spending once; net balance unchanged. State tax retained after credits because refundable-state split unavailable.
fixed_rules.universe_closure: Complete tax arms conditionally attribute all domestic receipts to CPS civilian household proxies. Other includes outside-CPS residents, with0 tax receipts implicitly attributed to them by this closure, not an observed0. Collective public assets use340110988 July2024 residents; target held observed40.896574m. Institutions, excluded military, territories, nonprofits and businesses are not observed as household tax units; this is not measured full-population incidence.
fixed_rules.external: BEA RoW flows observed; capital_external arms additionally assume an explicit foreign/nonresident capital burden fraction. Unknown domestic incidence is never silently renamed external.
fixed_rules.no_policy_claim: Assigned burden/collective ownership is not revenue that disappears if the population disappears. No fiscal net balance or welfare offset estimated here.
